name: BU-LAD
summary: BU-LAD, also known as 6-butyl-6-nor-LSD or 6-butyl-6-nor-lysergic acid diethylamide, is a psychedelic drug and analogue of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) first described by David E. Nichols and colleagues in the 1980s.

pharmacology.text: BU-LAD substitutes for LSD in rodent drug discrimination tests. However, it has 13-fold reduced potency relative to LSD itself and 37- to 42-fold lower potency than ETH-LAD and AL-LAD in this test.

summaryZh: BU-LAD是一種有機化合物，化學式為C23H31N3O，為迷幻藥物麥角酸二乙醯胺的同系物，最早由亞歷山大·舒爾金在其著作《TiHKAL：延續》中提出。
summaryZhHans: BU-LAD是一种有机化合物，化学式为C23H31N3O，为迷幻药物麦角酸二乙酰胺的同系物，最早由亚历山大·舒尔金在其著作《TiHKAL：延续》中提出。

uses.en: It is a research chemical used to study how changes to the LSD molecule affect its activity. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究化學品，用於探討 LSD 分子的改動如何影響其活性，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究化学品，用于探讨 LSD 分子的改动如何影响其活性，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Almost nothing is known about it in people. Lysergamide psychedelics such as LSD can cause anxiety, confusion, altered perception and a raised heart rate, and can trigger psychosis in people who are prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響幾乎一無所知。LSD 等麥角醯胺類迷幻藥可能造成焦慮、混亂、知覺改變與心跳加快，並可能在易感者身上誘發精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响几乎一无所知。LSD 等麦角酰胺类迷幻药可能造成焦虑、混乱、知觉改变与心跳加快，并可能在易感者身上诱发精神病。

fact.en: It is LSD with a butyl group where LSD has a methyl, and it was first described by David Nichols and colleagues in the 1980s. In rodent tests it stands in for LSD but is much weaker than AL-LAD or ETH-LAD.
fact.zh: 它是把 LSD 的甲基換成丁基的產物，最早由 David Nichols 與同事在 1980 年代描述。在囓齒動物測試中它能替代 LSD，但效力遠弱於 AL-LAD 與 ETH-LAD。
fact.zhHans: 它是把 LSD 的甲基换成丁基的产物，最早由 David Nichols 与同事在 1980 年代描述。在囓齿动物测试中它能替代 LSD，但效力远弱于 AL-LAD 与 ETH-LAD。
